stories.title: Packers star RB Jacobs formally charged by DA
stories.summary: Packers running back Josh Jacobs was charged with misdemeanor battery and misdemeanor criminal damage to property, according to Wisconsin court records.

stories.title: ACC joins other P4 conferences in banning pros
stories.summary: The ACC passed a resolution Thursday banning professionals from returning to college in football, plus men's and women's basketball, joining the other Power 4 conferences in setting forth eligibility enforcement.

stories.title: Good Good out as PGA Tour event title sponsor
stories.summary: Good Good Golf is stepping away from its sponsorship of a PGA Tour tournament in November.

stories.title: Judge's order prohibits SEC from banning players
stories.summary: A Dallas judge signed an order Thursday that prohibits the NCAA, the SEC and its commissioner Greg Sankey from stopping a group of athletes from returning to college sports for one more season of play.

stories.title: Lee starts hot at Tour Championship, up 2 after 62
stories.summary: Min Woo Lee tied a career low on the PGA Tour by firing a 62 on Thursday to take a two-shot lead in the Tour Championship.
